newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech started as buy.

text.p: Montgomery Securities analyst Jeffrey Lin started coverage of Israel's Orbotech Ltd Friday with a rating of buy.
-- "Orbotech is in the position to increase sales owing to its solid sales and support infrastructure with minimal increases in operating expenses," Lin wrote in a report.
-- He forecast earnings per share of $2.01 and $2.43 for fiscal years 1997 and 1998, respectively. He set a target price of $39 a share.
-- Orbotech's American Depositary Receipts were up 2-1/4 to 32 in heavy mid-afternoon trade. The company makes optical systems that find defects during manufacturing.
